notes: diagnose carries the SAME services block as service_status — that is the point of wiring service_health into it, and the reason both routes to the answer are fixtured identically. A contestant that reaches the truth through diagnose has read it just as honestly as one that called service_status, so the task grades the answer rather than the route. The recent_errors list is real in shape and deliberately unhelpful: it shows the SYMPTOM (web_search failing on DNS) with nothing about a mount, so an answer that stops there has not found the cause.

entries.notes: Matches with or without an `area` argument — either is a legitimate way to ask.
